supplementaryReferences.title: Edible part and local use
supplementaryReferences.quote: The sweet vitamin C-enriched fruit can be enjoyed on its own
supplementaryReferences.note: Dried-fruit flour is a documented traditional end use, not a supplied safe storage duration. October–March is flowering.

care: Use sun and well-drained soil. SANBI records dry bushveld, sandy-soil preference and frost hardiness; avoid over-watering established plants.
purchase: Ask for Grewia flava and confirm local provenance. No named food cultivar or fruit kg was verified.
